title: Implement Library Route Map phase 5
summary: Add validation handoff evidence for Library Route Map using Sample Validation, Completed, Pending Publish, Diagnostics, and command-history signals.
reason: Route-map evidence must clearly distinguish planned policy from proof produced by completed jobs, pending publish, and sample validation.
behavior_before: The Libraries tab had no route-map validation handoff and could not separate completed, pending-publish, sample-validation, diagnostics, and command evidence.
behavior_after: A read-only validation endpoint and Libraries panel show distinct proof categories and safe next steps without adding launch, drain, accept, repair, rename, or save controls.
manual_validation: mutation-boundary tests prove route-map frontend does not call launch, drain, accept, repair, rename, queue mutation, sample append, or settings save routes
validation handoff test proves sample_validation, completed, pending_publish, diagnostics, and command_history remain distinct proof sections
rollback_plan: Remove the validation handoff route, WebView validation panel, related tests, summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Validation handoff labels proof categories separately and remains evidence-only. No media mutation, drain, repair, launch, rename, or settings save controls are introduced.
